name: cbom-builder
description: Generate a Cryptography Bill of Materials (CBOM) from a Node.js package.json

scripts.scan:ss: rimraf examples/second-service/cbom.cdx.json examples/second-service/cbom.md && ts-node src/cli/bin.ts scan examples/second-service --out examples/second-service
scripts.scan:ss:live: rimraf examples/second-service/cbom.cdx.json examples/second-service/cbom.md && ts-node src/cli/bin.ts scan examples/second-service --live --out examples/second-service
scripts.scan:sna:live: rimraf examples/sample-node-app/cbom.cdx.json examples/sample-node-app/cbom.md && ts-node src/cli/bin.ts scan examples/sample-node-app --live --out examples/sample-node-app
